title: Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation reformulates sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation by encoding items into semantic tokens, enabling improved scaling capability and cross-domain generalization. However, existing generative recommender systems typically follow a two-stage pipeline, where item tokenization is largely dominated by textual semantics with limited incorporation of collaborative signals and interaction similarity, leading to code assignments that are misaligned with downstream generation. Conversely, the generation stage tends to overlook the original semantic information, as the code sequences are re-embedded based on interaction data. This cross-stage information decoupling limits semantic coherence and recommendation accuracy. translated_title: 解决生成式推荐中语义信号与协同信号的跨阶段解耦问题
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐通过将物品编码为语义标记，把序列推荐重新表述为自回归生成任务，从而获得更好的扩展能力和跨域泛化性能。然而，现有的生成式推荐系统通常遵循两阶段流水线，其中物品标记化主要由文本语义主导，协同信号和交互相似性的融入十分有限，导致码本分配与下游生成阶段不对齐。反过来，生成阶段往往会忽略原始的语义信息，因为代码序列是基于交互数据重新嵌入的。这种跨阶段的信息解耦限制了语义一致性和推荐准确性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SCRec，一个通过双向信息补充来增强跨阶段一致性的通用框架。具体而言，我们引入了(i)协同……（摘要不完整，截断于此）
tldr: 本文提出SCRec通用框架，通过双向信息补充机制解决生成式推荐中物品标记化阶段与生成阶段之间语义信号与协同信号解耦的问题，从而提升语义一致性和推荐准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCRec, a general framework that addresses the cross-stage decoupling of semantic and collaborative signals between item tokenization and generation stages in generative recommendation through bidirectional information supplementation, improving semantic coherence and recommendation accuracy.
